layout.automatic: This email was sent automatically, please do not reply.

invitation.subject: Invitation to join an organization
invitation.title: Join {organizationName} on {brandName}
invitation.body: {inviterName} has invited you to join the organization {organizationName} as {roleName}.
invitation.validity: This link is valid for 7 days.
invitation.ignore: If you were not expecting this invitation, you can ignore it.

rfqReceived.subject: New request for quotation from {buyerName}
rfqReceived.title: {buyerName} is consulting you on {brandName}
rfqReceived.body: {buyerName} invites you to quote on the request “{rfqTitle}” ({itemCount, plural, one {# line} other {# lines}}).
rfqReceived.footer: Sign in to your supplier area to view the request or decline it.

passwordReset.subject: Reset your password
passwordReset.title: Reset your password
passwordReset.body: You asked to reset the password of your {brandName} account.
passwordReset.validity: This link is valid for {minutes, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}} and can only be used once.
passwordReset.ignore: If you did not make this request, you can ignore it: your password will not be changed.

emailVerification.subject: Confirm your email address
emailVerification.title: Confirm your email address
emailVerification.body: Welcome to {brandName}! To activate your account, please confirm that this email address is yours.
emailVerification.validity: This link is valid for {hours, plural, one {# hour} other {# hours}}.
emailVerification.ignore: If you did not create an account, you can ignore this email.

welcome.subject: Welcome to {brandName}
welcome.title: Welcome {name}!
welcome.body: Your {brandName} account has been created. You can now sign in and start using the application.

rfqReminder.subject: Reminder: request for quotation “{rfqTitle}”
rfqReminder.title: Reminder: “{rfqTitle}” is waiting for your reply
rfqReminder.body: {buyerName} sent you the request “{rfqTitle}” and you have not opened it yet.
rfqReminder.footer: This is the only reminder for this request. You can also decline it from your supplier area.

quoteReceived.subject: New quote from {supplierName} for “{rfqTitle}”
quoteReceived.title: {supplierName} submitted a quote
quoteReceived.footer: You are receiving this message because you manage this request for quotation.

agencyReview.footer: You are receiving this message because you are responsible for this signup.

approved.subject: Your signup is approved
approved.title: Your agency is approved
approved.body: The team approved the signup of “{organizationName}”: your account is fully active.

rejected.subject: Your signup was not accepted
rejected.title: Signup not accepted
rejected.body: The team could not approve the signup of “{organizationName}”. The account has been deactivated.

info_requested.subject: More information needed
info_requested.title: More information needed
info_requested.body: To approve the signup of “{organizationName}”, the team needs more information. Please reply to this email.

announcement.footer: You are receiving this message because you have an account on {brandName}.
